history.summary: Freehold 1BR at Tivoli Grande, D15 (Eunos/Frankel side), asking $900k at $1,607 PSF for an efficient 560 sqft. PSF sits right at the $1,602 median (no discount), and the 6.51%/yr URA rate rests on a modest 30-txn boutique sample.
history.rating_rationale: Freehold and a reasonable D15 entry quantum are pluses, but the case is undifferentiated: priced at the median (no value gap), 30 txns make the 6.51% rate only borderline reliable, 1.03km from Eunos MRT (12-min walk) is soft, and it's a small/boutique development with limited liquidity. Decent freehold hold, no investment edge.
red_flags: 1.03km from MRT, boutique development = thinner liquidity

history.summary: Freehold 1BR in D15 (Marine Parade/Koon Seng) priced fairly at $1,607 psf vs verified project average ~$1,593 psf — the algo's -25% cheapness signal is a data quirk (psf_cohort_txns=0), not a real bargain.
history.rating_rationale: Web-verified last-12-month transactions average ~$1,593 psf with a high of $1,740 psf; the $1,607 asking is essentially at-market, NOT the -25% bargain the dossier implies. Critically, psf_cohort_txns is 0, so the age_adj_premium of -25.0% is computed off district peers with no same-size comp — exactly the thin-data quirk the v3.4 prior warns against, so I lower confidence in the cheapness claim. The asset itself is sound: freehold, 5-min walk to Eunos MRT, ~3.6% yield, desirable East Coast lifestyle. But with no verified discount and the value signal unreliable, there's no margin of safety to justify a Buy. Fairly-priced freehold in a good district = hold/Neutral.
